name: Dogfood: gradle check
description: Run the repo quality gates as a staged, fail-fast Yukta workflow.

tool.description: Run one shell command (gradle, go, pnpm, ...) in one project, once. The caller decides what a failure means. An empty command passes with a warning.

nodes.description: Runs the command in the project (src/tool.ts) and passes its output and exit code on.

config.reason: the command exited non-zero or timed out

check.description: The scoped, self-healing quality gate: one tool call per planned stage, a failed stage goes to heal (yk check)

attempt.description: One repair attempt: one Claude session at one model and effort, judged by re-running the failed stage.

nodes.description: Start: the problems of the failed stage and what the previous attempt said.
Writes the prompt, the rules and the MCP config of this attempt; refuses when the budget check says no.
Runs the Claude fixer session (the agent workflow) at this attempt's model and effort.
Records what the fixer says it did.
Runs the project formatter over what the fixer changed.
The guard: rejects edits outside what a fixer may touch (config, build-logic, CI, this folder).
Re-runs the failed stage: this decides whether the attempt worked.
Writes the attempt record (cost, tokens, changed files) and says whether the stage is fixed.
Did the stage pass after the attempt?
The attempt fixed the stage.

config.reason: the attempt did not fix the stage

nodes.description: The attempt did not fix the stage; heal goes to the next rung.

heal.description: Repair a failed stage: the free automatic fix first, then a fixed ladder of model and effort (heal.json ladder), one attempt each, until the stage passes.

nodes.description: Start: the failed stage, its output and the heal options.
Is healing on? (yk check --no-heal turns it off.)
Healing is off: the stage stays failed.
Does this stage have a free automatic fix (a formatter, a generator)?
Runs the free fix: no model, no cost.
Re-runs the stage after the free fix; only a stage that still fails goes on to a model.
Records that the free fix healed the stage.
Builds the brief for the fixers: the problems, and whether the stage already fails the same way on a clean origin/main.
Takes the problems of the brief as the input of the first rung.
Does the stage already fail the same way on origin/main?

config.reason: the stage already fails the same way on origin/main: a known baseline failure, no fixer was started

nodes.description: A known failure of origin/main: no fixer is started, the stage stays failed.

agent.description: One fixer-grade Claude Code session on the AGENT_SESSION plugin; the payload carries the answer, its cost and its turns.

nodes.description: Start: the prompt of the session (model, effort, budget, rules and MCP config come as start variables).
The Claude Code session itself (AGENT_SESSION, harness claude-code); its answer, cost and turns go into the payload.
The session finished: the payload carries its answer.
The session failed: the payload says why.
The session stopped early (budget or time box): the payload carries what it had.
